reviews.decision_reason: select_demand applies the apparent threshold/fallback rule in its own boundary: demand_score >= 8 plus explicit fallback_ids n06-r07 and n06-r08. Runtime state shows its selected output has 4 rows, so the later one-row output is not localized here.

normalize receives a 4-row selected demand DataFrame but hard-codes index_window = [0] and returns retained_df.head(len(index_window)), producing only 1 row. This drops selected/fallback demand records before handoff, contradicting the role to preserve allowed corpus identifiers and causing downstream needs/evidence_sources to contain only n06-r01.

assemble_provenance deterministically ranks and emits provenance for the normalized needs it receives. Its one-row output follows from the upstream normalize truncation, so this boundary is downstream of the localized fault rather than independently defective.
